checks.note: Dedicated SA, not default. The only other SA on the IAM role is clinic-agent-reminders (deployment.yaml:131), a CronJob running the same agent image, so it is not an unrelated service.

Eligibility uses the workload token exchange. EHR uses per-clinic client_credentials from Secrets Manager and payments uses a per-clinic restricted key from Secrets Manager (both fetched via the agent's IAM role). No client forwards the request Authorization header or cookie; webchat.ts:23 only reads it to authenticate the inbound user.

The user is a separate Subject field in RunContext, distinct from the agent identity() fields. The patient is carried in the exchange scope while the workload token stays the agent's own. No user token replaces the agent identity.
Permissions attach to the clinic-agent-runtime role, which is assumable only by the agent service accounts via IRSA. Users never receive AWS credentials, so removing the role does not touch them.

note: No check could be shown false; the role is shared only between the agent and its own reminders CronJob.
